title: Otto Skorzeny's ratline used Knights of Malta passports

tellings.quote: Yeah. Auto Scorzani, who ran the rat line, you know, of of smuggling them all out of there. And they were knights of Malta passports.

plain: Otto Skorzeny, who ran a ratline, a secret escape route for smuggling people out of Europe, is said to have used passports from the Catholic order of the Knights of Malta to get them out. A guest named Dan Sheehan tells Michels this in passing, as something he has learned rather than seen. If true, it would tie a religious order to the smuggling network.
